assertions.reason: Registration toggle propagated to /api/config (false), login hid Sign up, and POST /api/auth/register returned 403 'Registration is not allowed.'; however direct /register still rendered the registration form instead of redirect/disabled state, and valid-invite/LDAP branches were not exercised.

Fresh local registration/login succeeded, but first-session modelPermissions for the new non-admin user did not match the documented default allowlist; superadmin retained a larger model catalog than restricted users. Federated/auto-provisioned path was unavailable in this environment.

Superadmin successfully patched per-user modelPermissions (200) and the target user's /api/models updated immediately; invalid endpoint/model overrides returned 400; workspace-admin override attempt returned 403; superadmin-target model-access control was non-applicable (disabled in UI).

Server-side restriction was observed on filtered /api/models and blocked-model assistants chat path ('Illegal request'), but full contract coverage across config model-spec filtering plus chat/agents/assistants create-update-revert and saved preset/model-spec re-entry paths was not completed; ban/rate-limit controls also interrupted follow-up checks.

Superadmin sync check passed (/api/admin/permissions isSuperAdmin=true) and registration gating API checks passed, but direct /register still rendered form under disabled registration, invite-signup branch was not executed, and new local-user first-session model defaults did not align with documented policy.

Superadmin admin-console flows and per-user model-access overrides worked (including invalid-combination 400 rejection and resulting user-visible model-list change), but provider-settings update flow itself was only observed (controls visible) and not fully executed end-to-end.

frictions.description: Auth throttling/temporary bans were repeatedly triggered during high-frequency login/API probing; required rerunning dev persona seed + API restart to clear limiter/ban state.
frictions.resolution: Ran node local-services/dev-seed-validation-personas.js then docker restart librechat-dev-api with ~20s wait.

blockers.description: No invite token flow was available within this execution path, so the valid-invite signup branch of VAL-AUTH-001 / VAL-CROSS-001 could not be directly exercised.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Validated no-invite registration rejection path and UI/API registration toggle effects instead.
